| Chain step | Mapping |
|---|---|
| AI market requirement | AI server trends push PCBs toward higher layer counts, larger area, and high-speed transmission [33]. AI/data-center connectivity also includes high-speed electrical interconnect in the data-center portfolio view [1]. |
| Measurable parameter | The relevant SI/PI measurable items include IL / insertion loss, Xtalk / crosstalk, eye diagram, and TDR impedance in high-speed PCB/PCBA signal-integrity flow [3][15]. PCB test flows also list impedance, DK/DF extraction, IL, roughness, and Xtalk as measurement / analysis items [16]. |
| Required Oscilloscope capability | The oscilloscope must support high-speed electrical interface validation / interface test, because the validation-challenge flow lists “Interface Test” using scopes, BERTs, AWGs, and switch matrices [3][15]. For power integrity, scopes are also listed for Power Distribution Network validation together with network analyzers [3][15]. |
| Boundary | The passages do not specify oscilloscope model, bandwidth, data rate, standards, software option, fixture, calibration, or pass/fail condition [3][14]. |
